messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: service=inference-prod-eu severity=sev2 region=eu-west-1a metric=5xx_rate value=0.21 alert:inference-5xx-spike-az -- links: https://ops.metrics/reports/3305556789

sarah-oncall: acked. I'm oncall, joining. pulling dashboards now.

alex-eng: seeing elevated p50/p95 and connection resets from instances in eu-west-1a. error traces show ECONNRESET on grpc streams.

sarah-oncall: good note. can someone run quick instance health check? `aws ec2 describe-instances --filters Name=availability-zone,Values=eu-west-1a Name=tag:role,Values=inference`

jorge-netops: running network checks on VPC for that AZ. early signal: increased retransmits and tx queue drops on a subset of ENIs. may be NIC-level.

mike-platops: ELB target group has ~12% unhealthy, flapping. Trying to reduce LB draining TTL to avoid cascading stranding.

alex-eng: reproducing errors via canary - tail of model server logs: ```
2023-06-05T12:11:03Z ERROR grpc: stream error: code = Unavailable desc = connection reset by peer
2023-06-05T12:11:04Z WARN inference: kvcache miss rate spike
```

sarah-oncall: ok plan: 1) shift ~30% traffic away from eu-west-1a to eu-west-1b via routing policy, 2) scale up spare instances in other AZs, 3) contact cloud to confirm AZ fabric issues. executing step 1 now.

mike-platops: initiating route shift: `redwood route update --service inference-prod --split eu-west-1a=0.7,eu-west-1b=0.3 --reason "az net degrade"`

jorge-netops: creating short-lived DNS override with lower TTL for critical endpoints to bias clients away. note: clients using pinned IPs will still hit problems.

karen-cs: customers reporting inference errors in EU. prepping comms: "We're investigating elevated errors in eu-west-1a; partial mitigation in progress; will update in 15m."

sarah-oncall: metrics after initial shift: 5xx_rate in eu-west-1a down from 0.21 -> 0.12 in 3m, global 5xx trending down. p95 latency overall still elevated by ~120ms.

alex-eng: deployed fallback to lighter model variant for some traffic to reduce per-token compute and keep latency SLOs. Canary looks stable.

incident-bot: Note: oncall handoff scheduled in 45m @sarah-oncall -> @mike-platops. Reminder: capture runbook link: https://ops.playbooks/incidents/az-network-degrade

jorge-netops: cloud provider status page shows "network fabric degradation affecting a subset of instances in eu-west-1a" — opened ticket with support (case 543210). They're escalating to infra team.

sarah-oncall: good. we should avoid large drains on nodes so we don't trigger capacity shortage. keep rolling traffic shift incremental. also enable KV cache warmup in eu-west-1b to reduce cold miss cost.

mike-platops: scaling up 20% capacity in eu-west-1b and eu-west-1c now; ETA ~7m. running `kubectl apply -f inference-scaleup-eu.yaml` and patching autoscaler.

alex-eng: quick check: sampling traces show most errors are at TCP layer not app; consistent with NIC-level retransmits. good that cloud engaged.

karen-cs: updated customers with: "Mitigation in place; we've shifted traffic and are scaling alternative AZs. Some users may experience transient errors; working on full recovery." customers asking for ETA.

sarah-oncall: ETA uncertain until provider confirms root cause. provisional ETA 60–90m for full recovery, will update earlier if we see stable metrics.

jorge-netops: cloud support says they are doing fabric maintenance and may need host reboots in the affected zone; pushing for targeted restarts to avoid broad quiesce.

incident-bot: Incident timeline event: 3305557200 - traffic shift 30% initiated by sarah-oncall.

sarah-oncall: continuing monitoring. mike, please be ready to take handoff in 30–45m. I'll prepare a short severity note and action items for postmortem.

mike-platops: on it. also will run quick audit for any auto-scaling gaps and ensure idle capacity pool is sufficient.

alex-eng: logs show one rogue instance with repeated NIC resets; marking it for replacement: `aws ec2 terminate-instances --instance-ids i-0abcd1234efgh` (will leave to ops).

jorge-netops: confirmed cloud kicked off targeted host reboot sequence for affected hosts. monitoring connection resets decreasing.

karen-cs: customers asking if data was exposed — short answer: no, this is network/fabric level. telling them we have no evidence of data plane compromise.

sarah-oncall: update 18m after mitigation: overall 5xx_rate down to 0.04, p95 latency back to normal within 2 sigma. leaving traffic split at 90/10 to allow cloud to finish recovery.

mike-platops: taking over oncall in 20m. sarah, drop any remaining notes in the thread and I'll continue watch.

sarah-oncall: notes for postmortem: timeline, cloud case id 543210, instances terminated/replaced, traffic steering commands, customer comms, action: add proactive ENI noise detection to alerts, revisit LB drain behavior for partial AZ issues.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident state -> mitigated. Incident owner: sarah-oncall. severity: sev2 -> open for postmortem.

mike-platops: ack. I'll monitor for 1h then close. assigning follow-ups: me (verify autoscaler safety), jorge-netops (cloud RCA), alex-eng (model fallback checklist), karen-cs (customer follow-ups).

karen-cs: drafting customer email and CC'ing legal for wording. will share on #customer-updates when ready.

sarah-oncall: thanks team. great coordination. leaving handoff notes pinned to the runbook.

incident-bot: Handoff reminder: 3305560899 - scheduled rerun of traffic split to fully restore 100% to eu-west-1a if metrics stable for 30m."
